middle.name: Grape Shot
middle.description: Adds a spray of 5 sharpened grapes to the ship. Wiki: This upgrade grants the Monkey Buccaneer an additional attack which fires 5 grapes (6 with Big Bunch) at a time, in a 90° spread. Grapes deal 1 Sharp-type damage (cannot damage Lead or Frozen Bloons), have 1 pierce (2 with Naval Upgrades), and have an attack cooldown of 1.35 seconds. Like Monkey Buccaneer's main dart attack, grapes may be fired from both sides at the same time if there are targets on both sides of it. The attack has several crosspathing benefits: Faster Shooting increases grape fire rate by +33% Double Shot adds +1 grape Destroyer increases grape fire rate by +400% Aircraft Carrier changes the radial attack from its planes to front-shooting bursts of grapes Carrier Flagship improves the Ceramic damage and pierce of the plane's fired grapes Long Range increases grape projectile speed by +25% and increases grape pierce by +1 Crow's Nest allows grapes to hit Camo Bloons Favored Trades increases grape fire rate by +80% Trade Empire increases grape damage to 2 and grants bonus MOAB and ceramic damage

middle.name: Hot Shot
middle.description: Burning hot grape shot can pop Lead Bloons and set Bloons on fire. Wiki: This upgrade sets its grapes on fire, changing the grapes to deal Fire-type damage instead of Sharp, letting them pop Lead and Frozen Bloons but not Purple Bloons. Additionally, the grapes gain a damage-over-time effect that ticks every 1.5 seconds, dealing 2 damage and lasting 3.1 seconds. It can set Purple Bloons in this damage-over-time, but will not damage them. Tier 4 and above crosspaths have extra DoT damage from Hot Shot. Aircraft Carrier grapes from the main ship deal 4 damage per tick, remaining at one tick every 1.5 seconds for 3.1 seconds. The radial volleys from the aircraft become tightly packed burning grapes that also burn Bloons, dealing 4 damage per tick per 0.5 seconds for 3.1 seconds. Carrier Flagship increases damage per tick of both burning effects from 4 to 9. Favored Trades burn effect does 4 damage per tick, increased to 9 with Trade Empire.

middle.name: Cannon Ship
middle.description: Adds a powerful cannon that shoots out powerful bombs. Wiki: This upgrade replaces its dart attack with bombs that explode on contact, dealing damage in an area and spawning 8 sharp frags that fly in all directions, and it increases the damage of its Grape Shot from 1 to 3. The bomb attack has a cooldown of 1.3 seconds and its explosion does 2 Explosion-type damage onto up to 20 Bloons (30 with Long Range), with a radius of 40. Its frags can each pop 1 Bloon (2 with Long Range), their pierce and damage cannot be buffed, and do not hit the same Bloon that the cannonball collided onto.

middle.name: Pirate Lord
middle.description: Greatly improved power and can shoot many grappling hooks at once, plundering extra cash from each MOAB-class Bloon taken down. Wiki: This upgrade decreases the attack cooldown of all attacks by 35%, increasing the Monkey Buccaneer's attack speed by ~53.8%. The grapes deal 8 damage and deal +4 Ceramic damage (instead of 4 and +2), and deal 9 damage per tick instead of 2. Cannonballs deal +8 MOAB-class damage instead of +5, and their fragments deal 6 damage and +3 MOAB-class damage. Without Faster Shooting, the attack cooldown of grapes and cannons are 0.8775 seconds and 0.845 seconds, respectively. This upgrade grants the MOAB Takedown ability 6 hooks in total, and the capability of hooking ZOMGs at the cost of 3 hooks each. The ability's cooldown is decreased from 45 seconds to 30 seconds (25 seconds with Faster Takedowns), and hooked Bloons grant +100% increased pop income.

bottom.name: Merchantman
bottom.description: Generates cash each round automatically, and deals more damage when over 10,000 saved cash. Wiki: This upgrade generates $200 at the end of each round automatically ($220 with Trade Agreements), which can be improved with Central Market (+10%, up to +100%) and Trade Empire. bottom.name: Favored Trades
bottom.description: Attacks faster and deals more damage when over 50,000 saved cash. Generates lots of money per round. Monkeys in radius have increased sell value. Wiki: This upgrade reduces the attack cooldown of the Monkey Buccaneer's attacks, increases the amount of cash generated from $200 to $500 per round ($520 with Trade Agreements), and provides a buff to itself and towers within its range which increases their sell value by 4% stacking up to 3 times for a maximum of 12% (capped at maximum of 95% of their cost). Additionally, its damage is increased by ×2 if the player's cash is $10,000–$49,999, or ×3 at $50,000 or more; in Co-op, only the owner's cash determines the cash-based damage buff. Darts have a cooldown of 0.5 seconds. If given Grape Shot, the attack cooldown for the grapes are reduced from 1.3 to 0.75 seconds. Hot Shot's burn damage is improved from 2 to 4.

bottom.name: Trade Empire
bottom.description: Generates more cash per round. Grants up to 20 Merchantmen bonus damage and an income bonus that increases with every Merchantman owned up to 20 times. Wiki: This upgrade increases the cash generated by Monkey Buccaneer from $500 to $800 ($820 with Trade Agreements), and grants a Trade Empire buff to up to 20 other Merchantmen or Favored Trades. This buff increases the cash generation of affected Monkey Buccaneers by an amount which scales based on the number of affected Monkey Buccaneers. The buff also grants +1 damage, +1 Ceramic damage, and +1 MOAB-Class damage to all attacks of affected towers. Trade Empire grants the Monkey Buccaneer itself +1 damage, +1 Ceramic damage, and +1 MOAB-Class damage to all attacks. Additionally, Hot Shot improves burn damage of its own grapes from 4 to 9. Like the previous tiers, it also gains a damage bonus depending on the amount of cash on hand, ×2 at $10,000–$49,999, or ×3 at $50,000 or more.
